name: smwmusic-pok-mon-ranger-lyra-forest
title: Pokémon Ranger - Lyra Forest
description:
There doesn't seem to be any Pokémon Ranger ports around here, so here's one for you. I actually wanted to do Lyra's Theme from HGSS, but this is what happened instead lol.

Nice little grassland, little athletic theme. Also could double on the overworld I'm sure. you do what you wanna do with it.
